from rcb_client import Robot

+class CalibratedPanda:
+    """FK model aligned to the observed hand pose at the current joints."""
+    def __init__(self, q0, tcp_xyz, tcp_quat_wxyz):
+        self.q0 = np.asarray(q0, dtype=float)
+        self.p0 = np.asarray(tcp_xyz, dtype=float)
